method: Inspected all five full Poppler-rendered PNG pages at 110 dpi. Checked typography, tables, same-scale original/R36/R37 crops, saved L/R fields, exact changes, source-markup registration and separate inherited pending scope. Confirmed source PDF SHA-256, bytes and page count with pypdf. Text extraction was not substituted for visual inspection.

page_checks.finding: Summary distinguishes two actual marked requests, one box amendment, one observed-point amendment and the separate inherited new_000010:24 hold. All 20 development files unchanged and approximate 2 px uncertainty are explicit.

Same-scale new_000006:53 crops show xmax 503 to 495 and unchanged L point. The other edges and unavailable R remain exact. Explanation ties the yellow region to the lower sloping front and expressly rejects a second bottom-edge change from the thick lower stroke.

Same-scale new_000034:35 crops and original-pixel grid show L from (518.35,297.09) to integer (517,294), visibility 2 unchanged. Box and R point stay fixed. Table, grid and uncertainty explanation agree and do not overlap.

Both actual supplied JPEG details are legible. Previous analytical A/B marks are distinguished from the newly user-supplied orange/pink marks. Registration ranges, original image interpretation and approximate physical uncertainty agree with the bound evidence.

Inherited new_000010:24 is clearly unchanged and is not a third current amendment. Actual left remains unavailable; visible R and box remain exact. The closing scope excludes blanket deletion of small labels and does not imply a new training result.

limitations: Approximate 2 px visual ambiguity remains in the blurred originals and thick user markings; integer coordinates are accepted adjudications, not subpixel physical measurements.
The inherited new_000010:24 point identity remains pending.
